description: Places one order for several products from one or more BuyNearby stores. Prices and stock come from the live catalog. Creates a real order; the customer receives a payment link by text or email, the card is held and is only charged after the store confirms the order. Delivery or pickup.

tip_percentage.description: Only set this if the user explicitly chose a tip - don't default one in on their behalf
